events.text:
Thanks, Sofia. You're verified.

I checked order O-5111. The Berry smoothie ($6.75) is listed on the order, and it was delivered at 6:38 PM. I can't issue the $6.75 refund myself. Your account has had 4 refunds in the last 30 days, and our policy requires a specialist to review any account at that level before another refund is issued.

I've escalated the case to a human specialist (reference ESC-700) with the details: the missing smoothie, the $6.75 refund to your Visa ending in 4242, and the repeat missing-item issue. A specialist will follow up with you within 24 hours. I know that's not the quick fix you wanted, and I'm sorry for the trouble.
It's only $6.75. Why is this so complicated? Four refunds in a month is because my orders keep going wrong, not because I'm scamming anyone. Can you just send it through?

I understand the frustration, and I'm sorry your orders have kept going wrong. I'm not able to send the refund myself. When an account has 3 or more refunds in the last 30 days, our policy requires a specialist to review it before any further refund goes out. This is a review step, not a judgment about you. The specialist has your full case, including the repeat missing items, so you won't need to explain it again.

Your case is ESC-700, and a specialist will follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise what they'll decide, but I've made sure the request is clearly documented. Is there anything else I can help with on this order?
Fine. It's only $6.75 though, so I hope they get to it quickly. ESC-700 is the reference, right? Nothing else from me.
Yes, ESC-700 is your reference number. A specialist will follow up within 24 hours. Thanks for your patience, Sofia, and sorry again for the missing smoothie.
